title: Monday Quick Tip
subtitle: When teammates laugh
hook: A player misses, and two teammates laugh.
intro: The player who missed goes quiet.
statement: How you respond shows the team what is okay.
q1: Do you stop the drill and address it right then —
q2: or talk with those players privately after?
q3: What does the player who missed need?
t1: Every team is different. But teams feel safe
t2: when kids know laughing at a teammate is not okay.
cta: Coaches — how do you handle it?
ctaLines: Stop and talk. A private word. A team rule.
ctaPrompt: Share your team habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A player misses, and two teammates laugh.
It happens in a drill. The player who missed goes quiet.
How you respond shows the team what is okay.
Address it right away or privately after. There is no single right way.
How do you handle it? Share your habit in the comments.
